newsitem.title: UK: IPE Feb gas oil closes off lows, follows crude.
newsitem.headline: IPE Feb gas oil closes off lows, follows crude.

text.p: IPE Feb gas oil recovered from the lows of the day just before the close, dragged up by gains on Brent and WTI crude and some market-on-close buying, brokers said.
Feb gas oil closed on Tuesday up 75 cents at $200.50 a tonne after breaking briefly below support at $200 to an intraday low of $199.50.
For most of the day action on the gas oil concentrated on the Feb/Mar spread which was trading around $3.25-$3.50 at the close, down from $4.50 at the open and off the high of the day of $4.75.
"Otherwise it has been a very boring day with nothing driving gas oil in particular," said one broker.
March Brent crude oil was trading at $22.30 a barrel, up 25 cents on the day, by 1740 GMT.
Traders said the market was range trading, waiting for weekly U.S. stock figures from the API due after markets close on Tuesday.
